args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following the v2.3.1 production deployment. Per runbook, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified; all regions now running v2.3.0. v2.3.1 requires investigation and remediation before redeployment.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Both actions are complete:

1. **Rollback performed**: checkout-api was rolled back from the failing **v2.3.1** to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all production regions — us-east, us-west, and eu-west. The rollout completed and was verified.

2. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** was created for checkout-api, describing the failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 in all regions, and verification of the rollout. The on-call engineer has been paged, and v2.3.1 should be investigated before any redeployment attempt.
